bounded_literature_search.conclusion: No exact previous universal Hurwitz degree-2 theorem was verified. Cadoret Remark 3.14 says optimality is unclear. Neighboring quadratic descent results exist for rational dynamical maps and hyperelliptic/superelliptic curves, so no novelty certification is made.
